verdict.rationale: Baseten is a model deployment and inference platform, so versioning and rolling back deployed workloads is a fair question for it. However, the evidence does not document versioning, review, or rollback of automations. The closest items are stable dev/staging/production environments for deployments and config.yaml-driven pushes. These are adjacent deployment features, and keeping configs in git would be a user-side workaround, so neither earns credit.
